f01 — tr -d '\0' $ tr -d '\0' </proc/device-tree/model raspberry pi 5 model b rev 1.1 checks : the exact board model, revision 1.1. trap avoided : /proc/cpuinfo gives the processor (bcm2712) but not the board revision. cat /proc/device-tree/model ends with a nul byte and no newline, so it sticks to the prompt ; tr -d '\0' yields a clean line.

f02 — uname -srm $ uname -srm linux 6.18.50+rpt-rpi-2712 aarch64 checks : the kernel and the arm64 architecture. trap avoided : uname -m alone gives aarch64 and says nothing about the kernel ; the +rpt-rpi-2712 suffix confirms a raspberry pi kernel.

f03 — python3 --version $ python3 --version python 3.13.5 checks : the interpreter that runs the proof scripts. trap avoided : python --version may point at another interpreter — manifests explicitly use python3 .

f04 — gpiodetect $ gpiodetect gpiochip0 [pinctrl-rp1] (54 lines) gpiochip10 [gpio-brcmstb@107d508500] (32 lines) gpiochip11 [gpio-brcmstb@107d517c00] (15 lines) gpiochip12 [gpio-brcmstb@107d517c20] (6 lines) gpiochip13 [gpio-brcmstb@107d508520] (4 lines) checks : the header is gpiochip0 , driver pinctrl-rp1 — the pi 5 southbridge rp1. trap avoided : gpiodetect also lists four brcmstb chips ; the mistake would be to take “the first one” or gpiochip10 . rpi.gpio imports on this machine, but the layer uses lgpio / gpiod and bcm numbers.

f05 — gpioinfo | grep onewire $ gpioinfo | grep onewire line 4: "gpio4" output drive=open-drain consumer="onewire@0" checks : bcm4 is reserved for the 1-wire bus. trap avoided : the line shows as output because it is being driven at that instant of the 1-wire cycle ; pinctrl get 4 may show input a microsecond later. that is not a conflict. physical pin 7 is bcm4: reason in bcm, never in pin number.

f06 — vcgencmd measure_temp && vcgencmd get_throttled $ vcgencmd measure_temp && vcgencmd get_throttled temp=42.8'c throttled=0x0 checks : soc temperature and power/thermal state. trap avoided : reading only the temperature. throttled=0x0 is proof that no throttling is active or has occurred ; a non-zero code splits into current and past bits. the && guarantees both readings come from the same instant ; with ; they could be separated. thermal throttle reference : about 80 °c — 42.8 °c measured here.

f07 — ls /dev/i2c-* /dev/spidev* 2>/dev/null $ ls /dev/i2c-* /dev/spidev* 2>/dev/null /dev/spidev0.0 /dev/spidev0.1 (return code 2) checks : two spi devices present, no i2c device ( i2c_arm=on in the config but the i2c-dev module is not loaded at boot, so no /dev/i2c-1 ). trap avoided : 2>/dev/null hides the error message but code 2 remains — that is proof of absence, not a command failure. adding || true would turn the absence into a success : never do that in a manifest.

f08 — cat /sys/bus/w1/devices/w1_bus_master1/w1_master_slaves $ cat /sys/bus/w1/devices/w1_bus_master1/w1_master_slaves 00-666800000000 00-e66800000000 checks : the 1-wire bus enumerates two roms of family 0x00 . trap avoided : those roms change on every read and have no w1_slave file — they are ghosts from a floating bus, not sensors. a real sensor gives a stable 28-… rom and crc=… yes in w1_slave . the list recorded here differs from the guide’s : expected on a bus with no sensor.

f09 — systemctl --failed --no-pager $ systemctl --failed --no-pager unit load active sub description 0 loaded units listed. checks : no systemd unit in failed state. trap avoided : --no-pager is essential in cron, otherwise the pager waits for a keypress. --failed does not replace is-active : a merely inactive unit is not a failure.

f10 — systemctl list-timers 'athena-*' --no-pager $ systemctl list-timers 'athena-*' --no-pager next left last passed unit sun 2026-11-22 19:49:48 est 30s sun 2026-11-22 19:48:48 est 29s ago athena-health.timer sun 2026-11-22 19:50:33 est 1min 15s sun 2026-11-22 17:50:33 est 1h 58min ago athena-git-sync.timer sun 2026-11-22 19:51:00 est 1min 42s sun 2026-11-22 19:48:01 est 1min 15s ago athena-flux.timer sun 2026-11-22 19:54:33 est 5min sun 2026-11-22 19:39:33 est 9min ago athena-gardien.timer mon 2026-11-23 03:17:00 est 7h sun 2026-11-22 03:17:11 est 16h ago athena-vault-backup.timer (excerpt — 7 timers in total, return code 0 without a pipe) checks : seven athena-* timers loaded and their next run. trap avoided : measured today, systemctl list-timers … | head -8 returns code 141 (sigpipe) while the timers are fine. a head must never supply a proof’s verdict : truncate the output afterwards, not the pipe.

f11 — systemctl is-active … $ systemctl is-active athena-health.timer athena-health-web.service athena-vault-backup.timer athena-git-sync.timer active active active active checks : the four units queried are active at the time of the reading. trap avoided : is-active describes the current state, is-enabled boot-time enablement. code 3 means “inactive”, not a system error.

f12 — ss -ltnp | grep -e ':8080|:8081' $ ss -ltnp | grep -e ':8080|:8081' listen 0 5 127.0.0.1:8081 0.0.0.0:* users:(("python3",pid=240333,fd=3)) listen 0 50 [::ffff:127.0.0.1]:8080 *:* users:(("signal-cli",pid=1157,fd=16)) checks : listening ports and their processes, both on loopback. trap avoided : an open port does not prove an http reply ; follow up with fiche f13. -p shows the pid only if the user has permission.

f13 — curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' 127.0.0.1:8081/ $ curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' 127.0.0.1:8081/ 200 checks : the local homepage replies. trap avoided : -s and -o /dev/null hide the body and error messages ; a 200 alone proves the reply, not the content. ipv6 was broken on this pi (dual stack ~24 s) ; /etc/gai.conf sets precedence ::ffff:0:0/96 100 to prefer ipv4. elsewhere, force curl -4 .

f14 — python3 sys/health_status.py $ python3 sys/health_status.py dernier échantillon : 2026-11-22t19:48:48-05:00 température 42.8 °c (24 h : min 38.9 / moy 41.84 / max 62.6) throttled 0x0 tension cœur 0.7638 v uptime 76.2 h charge 0.21 disque 16.6 % (24 h max 16.6 %) unités en échec 0 wlan -64.0 dbm ntp oui échantillons 24 h : 1370 événements throttle : 0 checks : consolidated reading of data/health.db , systemd units, temperature and network. trap avoided : the script reads the database, it does not rewrite it. the alerts at the end of the output are historical (18 and 21 november) : do not confuse them with the current state, which is 0 unité en échec .

f15 — select count(*) from samples select count(*) from samples checks : the number of recorded samples, delegated to the database rather than typed by hand. trap avoided : the engine opens the database with uri file:…?mode=ro — read-only, the manifest cannot modify what it measures. count(*) returns 0 for an empty table ; that is not the same as a missing database.

f16 — git bundle verify state/vault.bundle $ git bundle verify state/vault.bundle the bundle contains these 2 refs: 360336371e5fc79e55bbf95cb517f4f7d82fdad0 refs/heads/main 360336371e5fc79e55bbf95cb517f4f7d82fdad0 head the bundle records a complete history. the bundle uses this hash algorithm: sha1 checks : the vault bundle is readable, complete and covers the history. trap avoided : verify does not prove the repository actually restores. the guide’s proof chains git clone of the bundle, git fsck --full and sha256sum of a known file.

f17 — git ls-files | grep -e 'secrets/|\.env|\.seed' $ git ls-files | grep -e 'secrets/|\.env|\.seed' || echo 'aucun secret versionné' aucun secret versionné checks : no sensitive file is in the git index. trap avoided : without || echo , grep returns code 1 when nothing matches (measured : rc=1 ) — a “failure” that is good news. the content of a secret must never be displayed ; only its absence is established.

f18 — git log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short $ git log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short 3d945a3 2026-11-22 sauvegarde auto 2026-11-22 18:55 checks : latest commit, short date and subject. trap avoided : without --date=short , %ad produces a verbose, locale-dependent date, hence not reproducible from one machine to another.

f19 — python3 sys/backlog.py etat $ python3 sys/backlog.py etat backlog : 129 tâches — {'fait': 42, 'bloqué': 3, 'prêt': 84} reste : 2495 min (41.6 h) prochaine : t30 — référentiel de commandes checks : the real state read from state/backlog/taches.json , and the next task returned by python3 sys/backlog.py suivante (here t30 ). trap avoided : etat gives the counters, suivante gives the task to run. a bloquée task is not a faite task. do not recompute the plan by hand : state/plan.md is regenerated from the json by script.
